stdout:
Delete playlist items. Use this tool to delete playlist items by IDs.

Usage:
  yutu playlistItem delete [flags]

Examples:
# Delete a playlist item by ID
yutu playlistItem delete --ids abc123
# Delete multiple playlist items
yutu playlistItem delete --ids abc123,def456

Flags:
  -h, --help                            help for delete
  -i, --ids strings                     IDs of the playlist items to delete
  -b, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string   ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
      --yes                             Confirm the operation
